req.title: Session cookie has HttpOnly attribute
req.statement: The system shall set HttpOnly on the session cookie.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the session cookie must have the HttpOnly attribute set. This is a security feature to prevent client-side scripts from accessing the cookie data. The test suite will verify this behavior by checking the presence of the HttpOnly attribute in the session cookie under different scenarios.

tests.name: test_session_cookie_httponly_positive
preconditions: The Flask app is configured with TESTING=True.
actions: Send a POST request to the /auth/login endpoint with valid credentials.
expected: The session cookie has the HttpOnly attribute.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'testuser', 'password': 'testpass'})
r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'testuser', 'password': 'testpass'})
assert r.status_code == 302
assert 'HttpOnly' in r.headers.get('Set-Cookie', '')

tests.name: test_session_cookie_httponly_boundary
preconditions: The Flask app is configured with TESTING=True.
actions: Send a POST request to the /auth/login endpoint with a username at the boundary of valid length.
expected: The session cookie has the HttpOnly attribute.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'a'*255, 'password': 'testpass'})
r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'a'*255, 'password': 'testpass'})
assert r.status_code == 302
assert 'HttpOnly' in r.headers.get('Set-Cookie', '')
